title: Run P2 and P3 role-run and neutral-smoke under limits-repeat3
goal: P2 (mini PC local) and P3 (mini PC worker, Mac inference) have live repeat-3 results on the same cases and budgets as the Mac P1 baseline
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures and the gauntlet packs only; local models on the enrolled NERV-01 and NERV-02 over Tailscale; 0 paid cloud tokens; raw reports stay in ~/.nerv-private on their base; NERV-01's live service (~/.nerv-app, ~/.nerv) is never stopped, updated or edited.
acceptance: role-run --role=both and neutral-smoke for P2 and P3 with limits-repeat3 (30 s/case, 15 min/suite, 61440 output tokens, repeat 3), the same cases as P1
Model, digest, runtime version, hardware, memory and sampled concurrent load recorded per option, including the mini PC runtime version
Pass counts, median latency, queue and network time and output tokens recorded as aggregates; raw reports stay private
validation: Recorded evidence for this slice; scoped checks and required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
A stop rule of the placement campaign aborts the run without fallback or retry
Anything that needs a credential, an unreachable host or the owner goes back to the owner; NERV-02 is left running

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 (F-006-T22): two packs on two placements at repeat 3, about 120 runs bounded by limits-repeat3; F-006-T11 live device steps took 1.5–3 h. Implemented 2026-11-24 in 1.5 h: P2 smoke 21/30 and roles 9/30 on NERV-02 (Gauntlet, limits-repeat3); P3 smoke 24/30 over WorkerLink; P3 roles blocked by B-119 and the probe's prompt limit (F-006-T27). Closed 2026-11-24 in the reconciliation: PR #698 merged on green CI; live runs recorded in the report.
